$comment: doc.new forwards its params to the engine command file.new
The result is file.new's: {"document": index} — the new document's index in the session list,
not an opaque id (vendor/photocraft/crates/engine/src/commands.rs "file.new" run arm: Ok(json!({"document": i}))).
Session id shapes: a document is addressed by its session index (doc.select/doc.close/session.list),
a layer is addressed by a u64 LayerId, and document revisions are u64 counters.
